stops.name: Besucherzentrum
stops.detail: The visitor centre provides information material about flora, fauna, geology, and excursions, and an exhibition clearly explains, among other things, the formation of the moor and the use of peat.

stops.name: Diamond Hill
stops.detail: Various hiking trails lead through the park, the longest of which begins at the visitor centre and leads to the summit of the over 400-meter-high Diamond Hill.

stops.name: Twelve Bens
stops.detail: It is located in Connemara in the west of Ireland, in County Galway northwest of the Twelve Bens (also called twelve pins), a mountain range with twelve peaks.

stops.name: Megalithanlagen
stops.detail: Relics of early human settlement such as 4000-year-old megalithic sites and standing stones can be found in the area.
